en: A colored illustrated postcard showing multiple vignette views of a town labeled "Gummersbach". The central image is a panoramic view of the town in a valley with hills and smokestacks in the background, captioned "Total-Ansicht v. d. Louisenhütte". Around it are smaller scenes: a building labeled "Sommerfrische Hermannsburg" with a windmill-like structure, a war memorial tower among fir trees captioned "Krieger Denkmal", and street views with buildings including a hotel labeled "Hotel Kögler Königl. Amtsger". Decorative flowers and ornate golden scrollwork frame the images. The lower half contains cursive handwriting in German, characteristic of an old mailed postcard.
